name: recoil_app_play_state_tick_and_render_frame
description: RecoilApp_PlayState::TickAndRenderFrame runs one gameplay frame tick/render path and returns the play-state exit gate.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.

The focused native smoke covers the documented quit-after-credits early return; full renderer/audio/HUD branch coverage is carried by direct-callee functional targets and the clear dependency frontier.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja HLIL and assembly at 0x42f280 show the frame-clock tick, optional debug script callback, input polling, render/display/window section capture, zClass bucket update, quit-after-credits return 1, clear policy, framebuffer selection, camera render, FX rect setup, software/replicate/primary postprocess branches, lens-flare draw calls, HUD/net-exit updates, presentation restore, and return 0 on the non-exit path.
The dependency frontier for 0x42f280 has no visible source or functional blockers after accepting the HUD update, net-exit tick, and lens-flare queued sample paths.

The native play-state smoke verifies the pre-early-return setup stores render/display/window section pointers and returns 1 when g_RecoilApp_QuitAfterCredits is armed while inerting input and zClass bucket providers.
